$comment: Accepted npm audit advisories for development-only dependencies, scoped to the exact dependency paths. Policy and review steps: docs/development.md. Production advisories are never accepted. An entry stops passing after reviewBy.

exceptions.reason: ESLint runs this chain at lint time only: @next/eslint-plugin-next uses fast-glob to expand settings.next.rootDir from this repository's own ESLint config (unset here), so no attacker-controlled pattern reaches braces. None of these packages is in the runtime image.
exceptions.blocker: No patched braces release exists (all versions <=3.0.3 are affected; upstream fix PRs are unmerged) and @next/eslint-plugin-next 16.4.0 pins fast-glob 3.3.1. Never run npm audit fix --force here: it downgrades eslint-config-next to 14.x.
exceptions.owner: operator (decision of 2026-10-12, recorded in the plan)
